counting_limits: Physical records, repeated copies and numbered source parts are counted separately; they are not all first decipherments.

Conditional geometry is retained in package summaries; summing modeled positions does not remove its assumptions.
Pixel identity binds a delivered crop to the pinned PDF. It does not itself prove every manual glyph judgment.
The source-image inventory includes two unaccepted-fragment diagnostic crops; those images add no accepted source records or plaintext positions.
